decisionScope: web-lite mechanics candidate, browser QA, placeholder theme schema and single-source boundary
decisionRule: Pass requires stable locked build; lint/typecheck/tests/build; desktop 5/5 and mobile 2/2 natural wins without obstacle-coordinate oracle; all three stages visited; white-column no-progress streak <=2; clean browser runtime; moving-support relative reflection; and production theme Zod parse plus one authoritative copy/color source. Future final-art providers, multi-theme proof, persistence and native platform packaging are reported but do not fail this scoped web-lite mechanics candidate.

isolatedBuild.command: node <workspace node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs> scripts/build.ts in an isolated rsync copy

remainingIssues.summary: The validated manifest is still descriptive placeholder metadata and does not construct the complete knife, cuttable, terrain, hazard and feedback provider set. This blocks claiming final art/provider replacement capability, not the current web-lite mechanics acceptance.
WeChat, Douyin and TapTap Mini Game packages and real-device behavior were not produced or verified; web-lite evidence is not platform publishability evidence.
The active placeholder theme is production-Zod parsed and single-source, but there is no second production-schema-compatible theme fixture with an identical core trace test.
The manifest schema enforces five strict entries but does not itself prove that each required role occurs exactly once; isolated equal-length invalid-field rejection tests are also missing.
No versioned save schema or persistence adapter exists, so cross-theme save compatibility remains unverified.

cases.title: Checkpoint and candidate hashes remain stable
repeatableSteps: Hash the checkpoint, dist/index.html, src/game-core.ts and src/theme.ts before QA.
Repeat the hashes after all checks.
expected: Checkpoint SHA matches the delegated value.
actual: dist, game-core and theme hashes were identical before and after.
cases.mechanicalCause: The final QA served the locked dist and wrote evidence only outside the generated workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: All locked hashes match before and after.
suggestedTests: Continue recording checkpoint, dist, core and theme hashes in every release QA artifact.

cases.title: Lint, typecheck and unit regressions
repeatableSteps: Run pnpm lint.
Run pnpm typecheck.
Run pnpm test.
cases.mechanicalCause: The blocker fix retains generic hard-contact, moving-support, sharp-contact, stage and theme regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: lint/typecheck exit 0 and tests have zero failures.
suggestedTests: Retain NATURAL-CHOKE-007/008 and THEME-ZOD-004 in the default suite.

cases.title: Independent deterministic build without touching workspace dist
repeatableSteps: Copy source/config to an isolated temporary directory excluding dist and node_modules.
Link the installed dependency directory read-only.
Run scripts/build.ts through tsx.
Hash the resulting isolated dist/index.html.
expected: Output hash matches locked workspace dist.
cases.mechanicalCause: The self-contained build is deterministic for the locked source and dependency set.
acceptanceCriteria: Isolated build succeeds and matches locked dist SHA.
suggestedTests: Preserve isolated reproducible-build verification for future release candidates.

cases.title: Five desktop and two mobile natural full-course runs
repeatableSteps: Serve the locked dist.
Run five global-height desktop policies through real mouse input.
Run two 390x844 policies through native touch input.
Do not read obstacle coordinates or use debug/state placement.
expected: Each successful run visits teach, develop and test stages.
actual: All seven runs visited stage-1-read-and-cut, stage-2-recover-and-choose and stage-3-structure-and-finish.
cases.mechanicalCause: The repeated-contact saturation rule lets varied natural rhythms leave the former choke while preserving ordinary input and level geometry.
acceptanceCriteria: 5/5 desktop and 2/2 mobile win without coordinate oracle or debug bridge.
All successful runs record all three stage IDs.
suggestedTests: Keep this seven-policy matrix as a release regression after every mechanics change.

cases.title: Former white-column choke and no-progress streak
repeatableSteps: Replay the lowest global-height policy that previously stalled.
Aggregate consecutive same-body bounce contacts with less than the progress threshold across all seven natural runs.
expected: Maximum no-progress bounce streak is at most 2.
actual: Low desktop policy won with maxX 3025.05 and streak 1.
Maximum streak across all seven runs was 2.
cases.mechanicalCause: The third repeated low-progress contact resolves as a tangent slide with separation, while the first two incident-normal bounces remain intact.
acceptanceCriteria: Low policy naturally wins and global max streak <=2.
suggestedTests: Retain the independent input/render cadence regression to catch changed-normal repeat contacts.

cases.title: Browser console and network cleanliness
repeatableSteps: Attach console, pageerror and requestfailed listeners before opening the locked build.
Keep listeners active through all seven natural runs and targeted evidence capture.
expected: No console errors, pageerrors or request failures.
cases.mechanicalCause: The self-contained locked build completed all tested paths without runtime or request failures.
acceptanceCriteria: All three error counters remain zero and preview closes.
suggestedTests: Continue failing browser QA on any pageerror or unhandled request failure.

cases.title: Moving-support blunt relative-velocity reflection
repeatableSteps: Load the moving-horizontal diagnostic without counting it as a natural pass.
Release at the recorded support phase and apply the recorded follow-up.
Capture handle contact, surface velocity and relative normal components.
expected: Blunt contact reverses the surface-relative normal component.
Exactly one impulse occurs during lockout.
cases.mechanicalCause: Hard-surface response subtracts support velocity before reflecting the incident normal component.
acceptanceCriteria: incoming relative normal <0, outgoing >0, and lockout impulse count=1.
suggestedTests: Retain both horizontal and vertical moving-support unit coverage in addition to this black-box diagnostic.

cases.title: Production Zod parse and single authoritative theme source
repeatableSteps: Inspect theme and manifest schemas and parse order.
Run THEME-ZOD-004 and THEME-INTEGRATION-003.
Inspect HTML/CSS for competing product copy, colors or token defaults.
Inspect core dependency direction.
expected: Theme and manifest are strict-parsed before presentation use.
HTML is neutral and CSS only consumes variables.
Core does not depend on theme, DOM, colors or asset filenames.
actual: Both exported active objects are strict-Zod parsed before main/renderer imports consume them.
Unknown gameplay keys and third-party/external entries are rejected.
HTML product fields are empty and CSS defines no second theme-token source.
game-core/game-content do not import theme or presentation modules.
cases.mechanicalCause: src/theme.ts is now the sole active product copy/color source and exports only parsed, frozen placeholder values.
acceptanceCriteria: Production parse, rejection tests, neutral HTML, variable-only CSS and core dependency fence all remain true.
suggestedTests: Add exact manifest-role uniqueness validation and an equal-length invalid-entry matrix.

cases.title: Known capability gaps outside current mechanics acceptance
repeatableSteps: Inspect manifest-to-provider resolution, second-theme fixtures, persistence adapters and native platform outputs.
expected: The final report distinguishes verified placeholder web-lite mechanics from unimplemented production capabilities.
actual: Final provider integration is not implemented.
No second-theme trace fixture or save schema exists.
No WeChat, Douyin or TapTap publishable package is verified.
cases.mechanicalCause: This blocker-only Builder pass intentionally completed mechanics stability and theme schema boundaries, not final art providers, persistence or native packaging.
acceptanceCriteria: Do not claim final asset replacement, persistence or native publishability until each has its own validated artifacts and platform QA.
suggestedTests: Add provider-consumption integration tests, two-theme trace equality, versioned save round-trip, and per-platform packaging/device QA when those stages begin.

platformScope.verified: web-lite development build and browser QA only
